name: Finch Frost
lore: A blue frost creature who carries messages across the winter wilds and reads storms by the sound of snow on his scarf.
passive: Deep Winter: Ice attacks build Chill and progressively slow enemies. At full Chill, freeze them solid. Frozen enemies still take damage and gain a brief immunity to Chill after thawing.

primary.name: Rime Spear
primary.description: Throw one piercing ice spear. Each enemy hit takes damage and gains Chill.
primary.ui_brief: Throw one piercing ice spear. Each enemy hit takes damage and gains Chill.

secondary.name: White Breath
secondary.description: Breathe frost in a cone for 2 seconds. The beam deals damage and builds Chill every quarter second.
secondary.ui_brief: Breathe frost in a cone for 2 seconds. The beam deals damage and builds Chill every quarter second.

special.name: Northwind Blizzard
special.description: Cast a wide snowstorm for 22 seconds. It hurts and chills enemies inside. Press Special again while aiming to steer it without refreshing its duration.
special.ui_brief: Cast a wide snowstorm for 22 seconds. It hurts and chills enemies inside. Press Special again while aiming to steer it without refreshing its duration.
